title: Sharp logarithmic exponents for fixed off-diagonal Ramsey numbers
exact_target: For every fixed integer $s>=5$ and every $\epsilon >0$, is r(s,t) bounded below by $t^{s-1}/(\log $ $t)^{s-2+\epsilon }$ for all sufficiently large t and above by $C_s$ $t^{s-1}/(\log $ $t)^{s-2}$, for a constant $C_s$ depending only on s?
